## Changes

- Fixed saving the clicked VolleyBoard when a note contains multiple boards, including copied boards and shifted block positions.
- Kept the editor open when the target block cannot be identified safely.
- Drawing tools now return to selection after inserting an arrow, freehand drawing, rectangle, circle, or text.
- Double-clicking a drawing tool keeps it active for repeated insertions, with a yellow border indicating this mode.

## Notes

Press Escape or choose Selection to leave the continuous drawing mode.
